_comment: ECU identification field offsets within the ReadEcuIdentification (0x1A 0x80) response payload (bytes after the SID echo + option byte). Drawing[0:11] and Hardware[11:22] are reliable for IAW5AM; Omologation/Software/Tester/Date offsets are best-guess — calibrate against a GuzziDiag-saved .txt if the values look off. Output mirrors GuzziDiag's .txt (CRLF).
